footoodle.title: Sign up for Collabore
footoodle.description:
Collabore opens the doors for developers and enthusiasts. Turn your static page service into dynamic ones.

Through a simple yet powerful interface you can modify, review, and create new posts, add plugins and apps to your pages, or embed your own extensions.

All of this through open-source code designed to expand. Use the built-in authentication system so Collabore users can register on your page in just a few clicks and automatically authenticate into your page's plugins and apps.

Be part of this collaborative system, register now!

about.title: About
about.p1: Hello, I am Lauro Moraes "aka" Subversivo58 and this site is my digital lab and personal blog.
about.p2: Here I publish content on technology trends, cyberculture, and web-oriented programming such as PWAs, Single Page Apps, and the use of modern JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 APIs
about.p3: I am passionate about functional programming, design patterns, and topics such as web decentralization ... blockchain and web cryptography are constant themes around here.
about.p4: This is also where I publish my experiments and share my code and small functional snippets, in addition to expressing my opinions on various topics, a bit of Geek culture, and this lifestyle.
about.p5: Feel free to explore the blog content and join our community.

you_in_control.item2: ✓ Cryptography as the foundation of all digital security.
you_in_control.item3: ✓ Respecting privacy begins with respecting your choices.

donations.heading: Thinking about doing something cool?
donations.photo: Photo by Clark Tibbs on Unsplash
donations.thanks_text: We proudly use GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers services; these platforms and their tools are truly amazing, allowing us to build cool things like this blog and our tools.

content.intro1: Keeping the blog up to date requires time and dedication; although the platforms and tools we use are free, they have limitations. Each one limits how many visits a site can receive per month as well as the amount of data that can transfer from its servers during those visits.
content.intro2: Here on this blog we love the idea of exploring new features, implementing new capabilities, and perhaps expanding our range of services as well as building a vibrant and dynamic community.
content.intro3: To achieve these ideas it is necessary to invest resources in getting our own domain, VPS servers that handle more traffic, storage space, and allow building a wider range of applications.
content.intro4: We abhor the idea of raising funds through ads, paywalls, paid tracking, or selling data ...we advocate and believe that you are the sole owner of your data as described in our "White Paper"; therefore, your little help can make all the difference, encouraging us and helping us do more and do better 🚀
content.contribution1: You can contribute to this blog in countless ways, by sharing it on your social networks, improving the code, collaborating editorially, interacting with our community, and much more.
content.contribution2: Also consider giving "that extra help" by choosing one of the donation options below 🎊
content.trademarks: The logos and trademarks used here are the property of their respective rights holders. Using them here does not imply any affiliation or endorsement by these brands.

dpo.heading: Data Protection Officer (DPO)
dpo.intro1: In compliance with the General Data Protection Law (LGPD - Law No. 13.709/2018), we provide the contact details of our Data Protection Officer.
dpo.intro2: The DPO is the person responsible for mediating communication between the Site, data subjects (you), and the National Data Protection Authority (ANPD).
dpo.deadline: Response Time: Up to 30 days, in accordance with regulations applicable to small-scale processing agents.
dpo.rights1: To exercise any of your rights provided under Art. 18 of the LGPD (such as confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization, deletion, among others), simply send an email to the address above.
dpo.rights2: To speed up service, we suggest including in the subject or body of the email:
dpo.list2: The right you wish to exercise (e.g., data deletion, access, etc.);
dpo.list3: Details that can help us locate your data in our systems.
dpo.policies: For more details on how we process your data, see our General Policy and our Privacy Policy.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.description: This Site was built using Web technologies; we believe in decentralization and cryptographic security. We believe you are the sole owner of your data.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: The privacy policy describes why this Site requests data, how it is processed, and explains how the user can edit, download, or delete their data.

terms.title: Terms
terms.description: The terms describe how we operate this Site, what our users can expect from this Site, and what we expect from our users in this process.

general.title: Policy
general.description: The "Policy" is the general document governing the relationship between the Site and the User, establishing guarantees and limitations for the agreement to use the Site and its tools.

overview.quote1: Policies are how the Site and users relate to each other; they bring security and trust while ensuring transparency and quality during this relationship, and are also regulated by data protection and privacy laws in many countries around the world.
overview.quote2: We tried to simplify our policies as much as possible to avoid the "alphabet soup" pattern. Not too much because too much does not guarantee quality, and not too little because too little does not guarantee substance.
overview.quote3: We hope this relationship of trust is a learning process both for our users and for ourselves.
overview.contact: Any questions arising from using the Site or its tools can be reported through our contact forms or feedback tools (we love feedback). We also invite you to resolve issues through our DPO at the following email address dpo.subversivo58@gmail.com.
overview.markdown1: The policies of this site were written in slightly modified Markdown markup language; you can view them in plain text or even download them on GitHub through this link to our repository
overview.markdown2: There you will find this and any previous versions of these Policies as well as the source code of this Site; you can also print them by clicking the print icon Print 🖨️ at the top of our General Policy.

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.paragraph1: We believe that the principle of privacy is freedom of choice. Users should not have to give up their data with a single click or under terms that force them to surrender large amounts of data just to use a given tool.
privacy.paragraph2: Freedom of choice is a progressive yet non-intrusive model for requesting data, and consent only when necessary should be a standard to follow.
privacy.paragraph3: Respect for privacy starts by respecting the User's choice about "what" and "when" they wish to share.

cookies.heading: Accept cookies
cookies.paragraph1: If you ask yourself: do I really need to accept cookies and data storage? The short answer is: no, you don't! You will still be able to browse and use several tools and features of the Site, though you may not get the best experience 🙁
cookies.paragraph2: For example: when you choose a language, save a favorite color, or define a setting, you will have to redo that choice every time you access or navigate the site ... the only way to "persist" your choices is by storing them locally.
cookies.paragraph3: Following our philosophy that you are the sole owner of your data, we believe you have choices. If you choose to accept the use of cookies by "clicking and holding" the button below, you can also choose to disable them whenever you want here or in the User tab, as well as remove everything already stored all at once 😎
